notes.title: v1.02.03 is now live!
notes.notes: [p]if you had a character that was not a spellcaster, but became one on changing career at level 5, he would have zero mana. Fixed![/p][p][/p][p]Fix for Ethereal and Vampiric - these only had an effect if gained by mutation, previously.[/p][p][/p][p]Corrected icon for Bloodlust.[/p][p][/p][p]Two new options added: No Screenshake, and No delay between actions. As default, these are both turned off.[/p]

notes.title: Sepulcrum!
notes.notes:
I have another game coming out at the end of June...

It features a roguelike style quest and turn based tactical battles - the latter, very similar to Fernageddon!

Unlocks, crazy encounters, artefacts, levelling up, powerful magic items and designing your party - I feel sure you will love this if you liked my earlier games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601900/Sepulcrum/

notes.title: v1.02.01 is now live
notes.notes:
Teleport spell fixed

One rare crash to desktop fixed

Fixed some confusion where minion bar showed level up but this was wrong

notes.title: v1.2 is now live!
notes.notes:
Beasts and Followers can now get XP! Or most of them can, anyway. Each creature has its own XP penalty. Some examples - Goblins and Cockroaches still have a 100% penalty. Orcs have a 75% penalty. Raiders and dwarfs have a 50% penalty. All characters that could take a class (Dwarf King, Elf mage, etc) still have a 0% penalty.
Each creature has its own career path (e.g orcs will be warriors) and beasts have a new career path with no specialisation allowing them to take some skills too.
Bear in mind - XP is shared amongst all participants at the end of a combat. Previously followers would be ignored. I've made some adjustments to deal with this, but...

Making the world map more interesting, graphically - I have:
Added different coloured patches of grass.
Made mountains variable in size.
I dialled this one back a bit, as I wasn't impressed with some of the other things I did. I may well return to this one in future - let me know any ideas you have.

Added Armoured Trolls and Minotaurs! You will occasionally see these fearsome beasts in some encounters, and you can pay a mystic to get your own upgraded with suitable armour, all for a very reasonable price.

New (very high tier) weapons! You will occasionally see enemy heroes wandering around with them too. Or can buy/loot them at appropriate places.
Araby (dagger and halberd)
Dwarfs( axe and shield)
Elves (spear and bow)

You can now pay for healing at a few places...

Journal added to show any outstanding quests...

I couldn't recreate the bug re flying high and fleeing, but I re-wrote things to hopefully deal with this better. Let me know if this bug is still around.

notes.title: v1.01.04 is now live
notes.notes:
Re-wrote "Move to safe space" routine for (4 tile) monsters. Occasionally they got this wrong and ended up overlapping something else with erratic consequences. (Usually this is used when fire is added to a square)

Fixed CtD that happened with over 100 floating damage texts on the screen.

If a 4 tile monster fled off screen, it wasn't tidied up completely, meaning it could still take damage and still blocked off some of its squares. Fixed!

If you got wiped out with some people in Injured Reserve (Or had a large monster that couldn't fight as you had gone underground) your party was marked as having survivors, which means the fallen got an injury roll, rather than suffering auto death. 
Back to auto-death now for everyone involved in the fight if they all fall in battle. You'll be able to carry on with anyone that stayed in reserve if you wish.

notes.title: v1.01.03 is live
notes.notes:
Fixed an infinite loop in the AI logic where enemy magic users wanted to move away from a threat, but had no AP to do so.

Reduced likelihood of fire spreading a little.

notes.title: v1.01.02 is now live
notes.notes:
One obscure CTD fixed.

Final part of Vampire quest event fixed. If you have already completed this quest in a game, proceed to the Vampire's castle to collect your rewards!

You are no longer allowed to use the Bound skill on a 4 tile monster to jump on top of an enemy, leading to all manner of strangeness.

notes.title: V 1.01.01 is now live
notes.notes: Just a fix for a CTD when trading with traders, if you zip back and forth between Inventory screen and Trading screen.

notes.title: v 1.1 is now live!
notes.notes:
Probably my biggest ever patch...

Heretic mode. Play in sandbox mode without any of God's hectoring. Just gain levels and find treasures. Battle against the evil minions of fire... The Fire God will occasionally send his champions to hunt you down...
I'm open to improving this further - let me know if you have any suggestions!

Expanded interaction with some existing legendary locations. They will now give you quests and rewards, plus you can trade and recruit at some of them.

3 completely new legendary locations.

7 new non-combat encounters in dungeons. (rare ones)

If you gain a powerful follower via a Glory reward, you will now get the option to instead choose an experienced champion.

New exotic traders.

Trade with all traders. They will always trade with you regardless of reputation. 

Late game events - Good factions may declare war on one another, The orcs may unite under a powerful warlord, the Necropolis may begin pumping out skeleton legions...

New Steam achievements x3.

Great Hammer added.

New rifle pic. (old one looked pixellated)

Efreet - fixed special ability.

Orcs and Goblins - no longer allowed to wear human sized armour.

Bows bumped up a little (+1 damage) and one bug fixed that double counted the penalty for trying to shoot round a blocker (tree, enemy, etc).

Fleeing re-worked.  On nearby death or flee - all units now get a saving throw based on how many of their team are left. Thus goblins will no longer mass flee after a couple of kills, for example.
With more "personal" morale drops rolls - on injury, a fear causer moving adjacent, some spells - this save doesn't apply. Let me know how this change goes!


Enjoy! I'm on standby for any bugs!

notes.title: V1.00.10 is now live
notes.notes:
Back to work! This should be everything reported over the Christmas holidays.


Fixed Injured Reserve! People moved to I.R will no longer participate in battles.

Fixed a bug seriously (and wrongly) impinging experience gain for very large bands.

Fixed Dark Herald causing some problems - no skills were assigned to this career on level up. Hopefully this has fixed the crash associated with this career although I couldn't recreate. (Please send me your save game if the crash is still happening, details on how can be found in the first post of the "Bugs" thread on the forum.)
A couple of other advanced careers had got their associated possible skills swapped too...

Fixed basic shoot action when you used the HotKey or click on the icon... (It always worked if you just clicked on the enemy)

Clarified and fixed the Will and Speed magic items tooltips.
Will now increases your Will statistic and gives you extra mana. ( 3 x level)
Speed - this one increases your move speed in battle. Updated tooltilp. Basically, you need less AP to move each square.
There is also a magic item that increases weapon speed - this is left unchanged. (Strike with the speed of a cobra...)

Fixed minor bug that made you go dark as if dead when you had 1 HP left (outside combat)

Baresarker keeps the Barbarian body instead of going back to the basic body picture.

notes.title: v1.00.09 is now live
notes.notes:
Just 2 fixes that caused crashes in the combat AI when an AI unit was at the map edge.

V1.1 is progressing nicely, I've finished all the art for it, now moving onto the coding now things have settled down with the bugs!

Merry Xmas!

notes.title: v1.00.08 is now live
notes.notes:
Fix a crash on loot generation in the end game - couldn't give enough items of high enough quality so looped! Thanks for the savegame to find this!

Increased late game enemy scaling - let me know what you think of this - still to easy once you have built a powerful band? Or is it now too much? Hopefully, I erred on the side of caution...

You can no longer buy items when your inventory is full.

There is now a warning on the inventory screen if your inventory is full.



Work is now progressing on some new content - full details in the Discussions forum.

notes.title: v1.00.07 is now live!
notes.notes:
Tinkered with the damage vs armour system! I think the most important feature for any weapon previously was it's armour penetration and anything without this (swords, bows...) were poor. Hopefully balance now much better!

Fixed repeated pressing ESC crash to desktop .

Fixed a couple of obscure loops due to lack of space in combat - when running from fire, and when summoning with nowhere nearby empty.

Lowered initial wandering enemy strengths considerably. You now get a longer easy period at the start of each game.

Toned down Last Alliance strength a little. (Surviving settlements send 1/3 of their troops rather than 1/2)

Changes to allow a generally bigger warband:
Removed the warband size subvert penalty.
Lessened the ambush penalty for a large warband..
Plus 10 to forage for all levels/biomes.

Reduced mana recharge rate a little.

Improved stock levels when trading at a Town.

No more credit for food purchases! (You could previously go into negative gold if buying food)

You can now view and copy your map seed on the Inventory screen.

Now shows Glory level on the Inventory screen. (Previously only showed points and what was needed for next level)

Slowed Glory gain a little.

Fixed Statistics - days on team. (new joiners only)

Troll, Minotaur, Bear all get some help in the form of armour penetration.

Spiders become size 2 like trolls, minotaurs and bears. This gives them some protection against being outnumbered and surrounded.

Minotaur reduced in size (graphically only - he obscured other squares too much)

Goblins and Roaches get a new more spread out deployment style - they were too vulnerable to one good initial fireball!

It's now a little more difficult to get joiners of the same type. (i.e. if you have 5 wolves already, less will want to join)

Increased Araby previous recruitment subvert penalty a little.

Added Araby General as a possible subvert candidate if you have a high charm score.

You now get a message from God every day if all the settlements are destroyed, to tell you where any Alliance troops are.

New Class heads for Liche and Undead General.

Fixed problem with endgame sequence not firing correctly.
(Apologies again for this, and thanks for the save games - I took the opportunity to do a re test of the end game to make sure it works OK now!)

notes.title: v1.00.06 is now live
notes.notes:
Fixed a memory leak when you reloaded the game - thanks to Redwitch for help with this!

While fixing also noticed several inefficiencies, improved these too.

So hopefully, no more GPU crashes, and everything will run a bit faster. (startup time and game load time should both be better)




** Plan Ahead **

Hopefully... that's the last of the urgent fixes! 

I'm going to try a run through myself, armed with a list of things that have been raised as concerns, and see what I think - hopefully getting a new balance patch out towards the end of next week.

Keep raising your bugs/issues/suggestions on the forums!

notes.title: v1.00.05 is now live
notes.notes:
Characters should now recover from temporary injuries properly once again...

The Counter skill is now limited to your range - e.g if an enemy pikeman misses you from afar, you won't be able to strike back if you are only armed with a dagger.


Added "The Outsider" starter background. As requested! 
It's a difficult start, one champion only. No gold and no extra starting equipment. The Fire God is a little more likely to take pity on you, and you have a better than average chance of starting with some of the more funky traits.
Good luck!

notes.title: v1.00.04 is now live
notes.notes:
Fixed a crash when fighting a fellow Champion of the Flame.

Fix to enemy wizards - will now cast all their spells properly.

Elf mages given their own spell group - it didn't seem right for them to burn down their own forest with Flamestorm! 

More tinkering with traits.

You can now use the copy icon next to the game seed to paste a new value, if the edit box is empty.

notes.title: v1.00.03 is now live!
notes.notes:
Possessed fix. This applies to anyone with the trait or mutation. Before you just got the big Strength bonus, but I'm afraid I have now fixed the downside bit...
Each turn in combat, there is a 1% chance of a possessed character attacking whoever he pleases...

Did you get a new follower but have no space in your team?
You now have one spare slot - the follower will go there.
He is in no way part of your band at this point.
If you gain another new follower, the guy waiting in the slot will be replaced.
If space becomes available, the waiting character will then join. You can use the existing Send to the flames option to free up a spot.

Fix to drop Heavy Armour when you specialise to a class that can't use it. (Assassin)

Reduced XP gain penalties some more - hopefully level 7 or so should feel like much less of a wall than before.
Before the XP penalty was based on your team strength vs the enemy team strength, meaning if you had a very powerful band, it was hard to get more XP.
Now the XP penalty is based on the encounter danger level.
A level 12 character is still going to learn nothing from a caravan combat, but will get no penalty at all from a dungeon boss, say.
** I think, if you are still disapointed with the amount of experience you are receiving, it probably due to the size of your warband. Experience is shared amongst all those that may receive it... I've added some new tips about this (main screen)

You can now see your current Glory level on the Champion's inventory screen, near level and XP.

Fixed the special character that can repeatedly attack for zero AP. (oops)

Forage increased by 5 points at levels easy and normal.

If you run out of food you can now choose who is eaten.

Fix to Arbalast, Dwarf Gunner and (Adventurer) Ranger who were all running the wizard AI (with no spells) rather than shooter AI. They should start firing now!

Charismatic Trait renamed to Extrovert to avoid confusion with skill

Poison skill fixed!

You can no longer give a hired Dwarf King new armour. It doesn't fit. He has got his own though, and it is very good.

Fixed double counting of natural armour on hired creatures.

Slight bump up to crossbows stats.

Fixed the problem with randomly ambushing orcs every night...

Fixed some sprite depth issues on the inventory screen.

Updated all Traits tooltips with more details.

Fix to non-human champions so they get a level bonus.


Still on my list:
Review of the effectiveness of Trolls and Minotaurs.
Review of missile effectiveness, including bows vs crossbows.

notes.title: v1.00.02 is now live
notes.notes:
Taureans and Hellhounds now need to be Tamed, not Charmed
Some changes to how easily beasts can be tamed, and some fixes for this.

Command skill now works correctly!

Juggernaut now doesn't work against (4 tile) monsters

Boost to XP gained in combat encounters (especially difficult encounters)

The number of traits a new character gets is toned down

Bug on inventory screen fixed, where you could move a potion in your potion slots on to a bow (for example) in inventroy, and the bow would move to the potion slots....

Increased mana needed for the most powerful spells

Glory experience reward at high Glory levels gave way too many XP - reduced, drastically

Capped all skills at level 5 (as originally intended - you could take a 6th)

Sorted out sticking tooltips on the Loot screen when you click and drag

Added text to loot screen "Tick" icon to show that you will be leaving loot behind

High flyers can now take morale drops - they can see what's going on after all.
Not having this lead to the situation where everyone on the ground was fleeing, but flyers returned one by one, totally fine.

When playing in windowed mode, allow minimise window.

notes.title: v1.00.01 is live
notes.notes:
Only two reported issues from the first day of full release - both fixed!

One obscure CTD.

One misfiring Steam achievement.

notes.title: v1.00.00 is now live
notes.notes:
V1 is here!

Balance changes
Minor bug fixes

** Plus **

Marsh biome visuals.

Improved new map creation, including making marshes a bit more common.

You can now change portraits of characters under the Edit option

More code to keep the world populated - extra ruins, raiders and wolves etc if the world gets too empty.

notes.title: v0.24.00 now live
notes.notes:
Mostly lots of small bugs fixed, and some performance changes.


But two new features:

If you run into the same square as a non-hostile party, you will now get the option of attack or not.

Weapons turn bloody after use, in combat.

notes.title: v0.23.00 now live!
notes.notes:
I'm expecting this to be the last version before Early Access!


New in this version:

Lots of minor bugs fixed.

Steam achievements!

Large scale overhead map you can call up to check your course.
I also made the togglable mini map a little bigger.

You now have the option to create a small/medium/large map on the New Game screen.

Refugees event. Once a few settlements have been razed, villages will begin to empty in favour of the Cities and Towns. This should make the game a little less grindy as you won't have to track down every last village - and make the last few towns and cities a little more difficult, as they will be reinforced.

Major balance changes:
Most Master weapons +50% cost
Most Legendary weapons + 100% cost
Potions - halved in cost.

Most easy encounters got a little more difficult
Most hard encounters got a little easier

notes.title: v0.22.00 is now live
notes.notes:
All skills and spells now tested. A lot of changes!

There are now a variety of fonts that can be used. (I noticed the "plain" font was not actually very plain)

Preach changes - removed infamy from the modifiers and replaced with glory.

You can now press ESCAPE in combat to bring up a mini menu where you can either:
Resume
Flee
Abandon game

There is a message in combat if a side begins to waver. This happens when the strength of one side is adjudged triple the other. The wavering team will have to take a morale check at the start of their turns.

There is now an indicator on the tool bar (red down arrow) to show that you are eating more food than you are foraging.

A lot of combat AI Vampire improvements.

New Goblin artwork

Rewrote how armour bonuses work. The armour points now just get added to your regular armour. You can only benefit from a spell once per battle though. (e.g. spamming Stone Skin is pointless, but you can cast Stone Skin and Divine Armour on an ally)

Unstable! Summoned undead are unstable. After a few turns they will begin to take HP damage every round until they fade away.

Fickle!  Summoned demons are non too happy about being torn away from the world beyond. If the battle is still ongoing, after a few turns, they may well turn against you! (When this happens they also become unstable)




Bug list is empty, so will be starting on new features again!

notes.title: v0.21.00 is now live
notes.notes:
Mainly, I fixed a bad bug introduced last patch with the new rules for bounding monsters - this should now be fixed! Hence the short time between patches.

The Options screen has been rewritten to have a more logical feel.
There are new options:
Slower action. If the AI speeds through its turns a bit fast for you, you can check this.
I also added a horizon range for the Strategic Map. Will be useful for people with older or newer, more powerful computers. If your PC can handle it, it is well worth tutning it up!

The "Will" skill has been renamed "Mana" to avoid confusing with the Will attribute.

The Ruin and Hell biome have had some more work done on their visuals.

Made the character portraits on the initiative queue a little smaller, as requested.

Otherwise, I have been working my way through the skills and spells. About 1/3 of the way through, and there have been a lot of small changes, both gameplay wise, and ensuring there is some sort of visual feedback when you use them.

notes.title: v0.20.00 is now live
notes.notes:
[b]Fleeing[/b]
Units fleeing now have a white tile base, so you can easily see who is running.
Units can now flee off either short map edge.
You can cancel retreat orders by clicking the white flag again.
If enemy are all fleeing you can click the white flag to get the "let them go" option again.
If you click the white flag to retreat, your units will no longer attempt to rally.
Pathing improved - units will avoid enemy Zone of Control where possible,

[b]Unit Focus[/b]
There is now an additional option to focus on AI attacks and movement. If the option is checked, the screen will scroll to centre on the action.

[b]Monsters[/b]
Get a new Leap ability. Before, they could easily get hemmed in by trees, rocks and fire, etc. They can now do a short distance bound to reposition themselves.

[b]Stratgeic map[/b]
Auto march on the strategic map - you will now stop if night falls.
Cleaned up the tree graphics so they appear less floaty.
Performance enhancements. 


[b]Misc[/b]
If you recruit any Raiders, they now have viking style names.

Flame Adept, Acolyte event fixed - It fired fairly randomly before, now linked to encounter danger, as intended.

Fixed level 10 career specialisation.

Some races (Raiders, Elves and Dwarfs) are now much less bothered by Infamy, to varying degrees.

A lot of improvements to the body/armour graphics for advanced careers. (Priest, wizard, shaman etc)

Special deaths! You should now see some decapitations and knock downs...

notes.title: v0.19.00 is now live
notes.notes:
Change Hilights:

All Encounters now tried and tested! (I've still a few bugs on my list though)

Watching Streamers play I noticed some animations were too fast and some too slow - fixed to check framerate properly...

New red tile to show currently selected unit.

Lots of tinkering with flee mechanics - still not sure if this is perfect, will be keeping an eye on it.

You can now click on a unit in the Initiative Queue and the display will centre upon them.

If playing in Windowed mode, cursor locks to window.

In combat, skill tooltips are now show in the bottom left to avoid cluttering the action.

Main menu - first option is now Continue to carry on most recently saved game.

Lots of work on the Goblin encounters to correct and balance. They're harder to hit with bows and no longer all flee as soon as one dies!

Loot balancing, especially early game. Early game the enemies are reduced in number. Now loot will be reduced a little to make up for this.

Shield did nothing against all ranged fire! Oops - Fixed!

Fatigue is now calculated at the start of each turn. Before, there was the strange situation where the game said 70% to hit, but then the log said 68%. This was because you lost energy for doing the attack which made your hit a little less acurate sometimes. Fixed!

Lots more minor tweaks and fixes...

notes.title: v0.18.00 is now live
notes.notes:
A lot of small changes... Fernageddon is really taking shape now!

Hilights:

Simplified level up process. There were some bad bugs here if you tried mixing up levelling up and switching between characters. Fingers crossed this is OK now!

Bumped up XP gain.  The game was much too hard a few versions ago - now it is easier, the XP award routine decided your battles were far too easy for a big reward...

The map should now be fuller - more ruins, dungeons and wandering gribblies.

Favourite obscure change of the patch - if you get one of the mutations that changes your head, your cries of pain switch too - e.g if you get the robot head you now make robot noises when hurt! And yes, I had to make some robot noises for this.

You can now interact with a lot more of the special settlements rather than just attack them. (e.g. you can trade and subvert with the Dwarfs)

If you are broken and fleeing you can now be rallied - and there is a small chance to recover by yourself if you are not in melee with enemies.

Add Minion tag for lesser critters - Imps, goblins, dogs etc. No morale loss for non-minions on the flight or death of a minion.

Battle Goes Badly - sometimes the odd archer, removed from the action, would still be at full morale even though all his comrades were dead. (protected by being removed from the action). If enemy strength is adjudged to be treble your own sides strength, you have to take a morale check at the start of every turn.

notes.title: v0.17.00 is now live!
notes.notes:
General balance changes and many fixes!

Hilights:


HP and Mana now regenerate slowly all the time. x2 speed if you are camped.
(Was previously all in a chunk on a new day)

Base Attack speed is now 45 AP. This will allow almost all one handed weapons to attack twice per turn (until fatigue kicks in). 

Enemies no longer walk through fire!

More work on death animations. (Twitching is definitely my favourite change of the update)
Also it sometimes looked like heads had come of when they had not.

Far fewer creatures are now immune to fire. (A bit unfair if you have built yourself a pyromancer)

Subvert infamy penalty reduced greatly. (Before, even destroying one caravan made it hard to recruit)

Encumberance penalty reduced for high strength characters (and increased for low strength).

Expanded starting party to make things easier at the very start of the game, and also to make the different starting backgrounds more varied.

Two new mechanisms to attract more followers to the band:
If you are doing very badly, God will take pity and send someone to join you. It will cost some Ennui though...
If you are doing very well (lots of Glory), wanderers will want to join.

Recalibrated all encounters - should be much easier in general.

New improved graphics for the tiles with combatants. (Yellow for your team, Blue for enemies)

WASD is now the deafult way to move the combat screen about. You can always use the cursor keys too.
This won't affect anyone already playing as some people will already have mapped their hotkeys.
If you want to change the key mappings, go to Options, then Hot Keys.

Swap weapon glitches fixed.

Expanded the tooltips on the View Character screen.

notes.title: 0.16.00 is now live!
notes.notes:
I'm going to delay the release by a month to give me a bit more time to get everything perfect - there is still a little way to go. I'm aiming for 30th November 2024 now.


Lots of bugs fixed, balance improved.

Cool new animations on casting a spell

You can now hold down <ctrl> to skip animations

Some of the professions were judged a bit dull, so I've added some new skills for them

More Infamy consequences. As you send more people to the flame, your Infamy level will rise.
At level 1, people won't trade with you.
At level 2, Larger settlements will send out armies against you.
At level 3, all remaining settlements will send out a portion of their garrison to join up and take you down!

Fixed Indirect archery

New trait - Talented, and it's opposite, Ordinary. 

Orcs, Goblins and Elves - some new improved graphics

Ruin balance adjusted - rewards and number of troops. Plus 6 new Ruin encounter possibilities.

A message to warn you if you are about to take on a challenge that may be too great

New death animations

New Ruin scenery look

notes.title: v0.15.00 is now live! (Beta)
notes.notes:
[b]End Game[/b]

You can now win the game! Destroy all to earn your reward
Enemies may well conspire against you once your threat is revealled too.


[b]Balance[/b]

Armour now auto repairs after each battle. While playing, I found I just did a 1 hour rest after each battle. It was a chore to remember to do...

Dungeon changes. You now only get 1 attempt at a dungeon. Flee or win, the dungeon is destroyed.
(But they will be a bit easier due to the auto armour repair, above)

More things added to map, so should be less empty. (Wanderers, ruins, dungeons...)

Glory rewards balanced and improved

Ambition rewards balanced and improved

Ambush balancing - some events marked as no Ambush possible


[b]Combat[/b]

People tired too quickly, so a flat +5 Energy recovery each round for everyone

Much improved Bow and Crossbow hit percentages

Various AI improvements

Improved synchronisation of animations (still some to do on this)

Increase range of panic check when someone breaks or dies.


[b]New Game[/b]

You now start facing nearest village (a hint you should go there)


[b]Optimisations[/b]

Various improvements for users with smaller screens like laptops.


[b]Fixes[/b]

Corrected champions with hair that went out of frame

Fix to transparent bits of scenery blocking view to a building, so you couldn't auto-move there

You can now cancel your Ambitions


[b]Other[/b]

Messages from God to tell you how you are doing and where your enemies lurk

Ceremonies! Use your gold to conduct a ritual to appease God

<F1> for context help on most screens

Skill matrix complete for all professions

Spellcheck all text!


[b] Cosmetic [b]
New Main menu icon - the old one is now the one for Ceremonies

New magic dagger pic


Plus many more minor things I forgot to write down...

notes.title: v0.14.00 is now live - Demo also updated
notes.notes:
Added option to turn off auto focus on unit whose turn it is.

Many more skills and strategies added to the encounters. Wolves will encircle you, Elves will use Hotstep to get away from you, Milita will Defend and Rotate and fight close together, Demons will mock you, Dwarfs will form a gunline...
(And many more)

Vastly improved the Specialisation process. Hot tip show the details of the profession you are choosing.

Tutorial added.

New Fly skill! Any creature that can fly can take to the skies (100 AP). It is off the battlefield in all respects. On it's next turn it can return to any square...

The way spreading fire works has been rewritten. It will now take notice of weather conditions, any terrain present (e.g Bushes burn more easily than rocks) etc. Be careful setting Hell on fire, fire will spread rapidly!

Armour vs Penetration rewritten. Penetration is now about half as effective as before.
(The most basic of hammers were pretty much ignoring heavy armour, and basic swords were terrible)

Rewrote Outnumberd and Surrounded combat boosts - should be more difficult to get the (very important) Surrounded modifier. You now need to have an ally on the opposite side, or adjactent to claim the bonus. (e.g. if you are West of the enemy, you will need an ally East, North-East, or South-East)

Added background pictures to all the inventory screens - some of the dark weapons were hard to see.
Legendary items get a nice gold version too.

Archers (Bow only) can now Indirect fire instead. Fire up and over, rather than direcly at enemy. It is much less accurate, but ignores blocking terrain. Can't be used underground.

New Legendary only item - Repeater crossbow. Fire 3 bolts at once.

Loot screen - fixes and now has sliders so you can see all your inventory.

Many traits and skills renamed to avoid confusion - e,g Brave skill is now Battle Hardened. Should avoid confusion when you used to have the Brave Skill and the Coward Trait...

New details added to F2 screen about character classes. (Free skills and characteristic boosts)

New Skillpedia, added - F3 hotkey. Shows all skills and descriptions in alphabetical order.

Fire and poison gas bombs fixed

Fixed Stun and Bleed modifiers for weapons. They are now shown on the tooltips also.

Skill changes - balancing.

Flame Acolyte/Adept/Priest. For winning key missions God will promote you up the ranks. Each gives you a few spells and +10 mana, regardless of class.
To be made an acolyte, you need to win a mission of difficulty 6+. (e.g any dungeon finale)
To be made an adept, you need difficulty 8+ (Destroying a city)
To be made a priest you need to defeat one of the 10 encounters (Pyramid finale, Dwarf/ Elf cities etc)

Hell battlefield graphics redone with a darker theme.

New lake and lava graphics.

New elf pics.

New pics for a lot of the common / tier 1 weapons.


What's next?

Balancing is the main focus now. I've been playing a few hours now and really enjoying, but some encounters are far too difficult.

Features next on list:

Messages from God demanding more action
F1 context sensitive help
Use Gold to make sacrifices to God
Tier 3 professions to be completed (They are just the same as their level 2 at the moment)
Endgame stuff
Steam Achievements

notes.title: v0.12.00 is now live
notes.notes:
Many minor bugs fixed, quite a few balance changes...

Great Weapon Sweep should now work properly.

Swap Weapons should now work properly.

If you are using the option to have the info box in the corner, rather than over the action, you will still see the percentage chance to hit (only) over the action.

Auto-centre of the screen on the person currently selected, when it is their turn. I was a bit dubious about doing this, but it's my favourite feature of the last few patches now. Makes it much easier to see quickly whose go it is.

AI improvements and new AI encounter dependent tactics 

If you are lucky enough to recruit a big guy they should now be a bit better. (e.g Trolls on your team were getting hit with unarmed penalty)

New sound effects (and one of the music tracks was silent, so has been removed for now as I can't find the original...)

All professions now in place, up to Level 10. Basically I've defined the skill matrix which shows what professions can take what skills, needing what coin flip. (Normal, Blessed, Chosen etc)

New Quickcast skill! (cast your spells for fewer AP)

New Hill graphics in the strategic map.

Fewer elites earlier in the game. Less likely to be crushed by an early minotaur now...

All wandering armies and garrisons slowly get stronger as the game goes on.

Tinkered with starting bands. Added a few new differentiations between the start ups, and generally, you get more warriors. I found the default Cultist startup very squishy indeed, so now a little more beefy.


The bad news is I had to disable the feature where you can hold down the mouse button to move foward on the strategic map, as it seems to cause a CTD for no particular reason.
It still works fine if you hold down the go forward hot key, or if you move about without holding the mouse button.
Hopefully I will be able to renable this at some point soon!


Next up...

I'm reviewing all the encounters. They're still a little vanilla now, but the critters will be getting a raft of new special abilities and behaviours.

notes.title: v0.11.00 is now live
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and optimisations...

Complete rework of the desert biome (it's been sadly neglected as my test runs rarely get this far south...)

Auto-move to landscape feature re-worked. Last version was prone to loops and getting stuck.
You can now also press ESCAPE to cancel auto-move.

You can now hold down the mouse button or forwards key to keep moving.

Some icons re-done

Glory points have been recalibrated. Completing an Ambition early used to mean you could get 3 Glory rewards in a row...

Lots of work on enemy AI. You may notice wolves will start to try and surround you, elves will fire and fade, zombies will protect their dark masters.... Lots more to do on this.



-- NEXT STEPS --

Will be looking at character progression. I want all the mid level professions (Levels 5-10) to feel unique and worthwhile, and all the high level professions (10+) to have their own unique skill.

Will be going through each encounter type to ensure it is interesting and different and fair.

Game balancing

notes.title: v0.10.00 is now live!
notes.notes:
Two weeks of changes!

Various bugs fixed, and the beginnings of working on balancing the game...

Sound Effects! Some turned out not that great, so I am using the ones from Leman instead. Lots of improvements to come.

Revamped Combat UI:
	Coloured border on initiative queue
	Actions made bigger (can be adjusted on options screen) and moved centrally
	Option to show enemies/allies (Base tile changes colour)

Armour and HP damage now appear together but animate a little slower. (When you hit someone, you see red and black numbers indicating damage done)

If all enemies fleeing, get option to end combat.

When moving on the strategic map, the scene will animate into place much more quickly. 

You can now click on a village/dungeon/ruin etc in the distance - you will then auto move towards it.
Still needs some work in unusual situations. You will stop if you are adjacent to an enemy.

5 new Traits added.

Challenges reworked. (and fixed)

I've started making some unique AI code - a lot more to do yet, but you will notice some differences.
Militia should begin to act like a unit, for example, while raiders will just charge...

notes.title: v0.09.00 is now live
notes.notes:
Skills, spells and mutations are now complete!

Improved a lot of the combat animations

Ennui is now a thing. If God get's bored as you are not burning enough things, he gets angrier, and eventually will enliven things by giving you a little gift. Most of these are  a mixed blessing, some good, some bad. But if you get too many of them you will begin to lose your mind... 
How do you feel about creating a big poison gas cloud every time you get hit in combat? Or getting a robot head that can breathe fire? :)

Forage is now a thing. This is my cap on band size. You can forage a certain amount of food each day, dependent on the biome you are within. Each member of your squad needs food. If you have Troll size or Monster size critters on the team, they really need a lot. If you run out of food then... Well, I would not want to be the weakest member of the band. Food can be plundered, or bought on the Trade screen.

Fatigue is now a thing. It's shown by the candle on the main map screen. Blundering about through the night can still be done, but don't expect your troops to have full energy when it comes to combat.
Rest often!


Coming soon:

I'll be testing the different encounters and critters. Each will be getting some unique AI features so they should all be begin to seem a lot less vanilla than they are now. 

Will be reviewing the Career and Profession system. Will be adding some unique powers and skills for each path.

Redo Traits to have a more fiery and fanatical feel. I think at the moment they are just copied from Leman...

notes.title: v0.08.00 is live
notes.notes:
Monsters now recruitable add moved to take up 4 tiles 

Bugs and locks fixed

~20 more spells added

Deal with bigger squads properly

notes.title: v0.07.00 is live
notes.notes:
All reported locks and crashes fixed.

20 or so Spells tested and fixed / improved. About 40 more to do...

Animated the action queue.

Made some AI improvements.


I'll be taking a break from adding in spells for a while as I decided to move the mosters to take up 4 tiles in combat. It's quite a big change as it will involve changes to AI as well as the display.
It will be worth it though as they look dumb squeezed on to one tile... :)

notes.title: V.0.06.01 live
notes.notes:
Fixed Raider camp

Fixed trading

Added variable prices in trading (e.g. you won't get good prices at a raider camp, much better at city)

Tested and fixed all the cantrips

notes.title: v0.06.00 is live!
notes.notes:
Some highlights:

Hopefully all locks and crashes fixed - let me know if you get any more!

Weather effects added

All skills tested and fixed (not spells yet). Key ones including swap weapons and great weapon sweeps etc too.

All enemy graphics sorted out, so no more floating tails.

Screenshakes and blood spurts on big hits

9 new champion faces

Mana now regenerates! (Also you previously only recovered 1 HP per day - this is now improved)

New way of showing who is selected - the old way was fine until you got into melee when it could obscure who you were fighting.

Many more minor things...

Let me know what you think!
